statement: Let ϕ(x, t; y) = x · y + ψ(t; y), x, y ∈ R2 , t ∈ R, ψ(0; y) = 0, be a fixed real smooth phase near the origin. Suppose throughout this neighborhood that M(t, y) = D2 y∂tψ(t; y) is definite, ∂tM(t, y) = c(t, y)M(t, y) for a smooth real scalar function c. On a sufficiently small fixed product chart, let a be any fixed smooth amplitude with compact support in its interior. For every 3 < p < ∞, Z eiNϕ(x,t;y) a(x, t; y)f(y) dy Lp(R3 x,t) ≤ Cϕ,a,pN−3/p ∥f∥Lp(R2), N ≥ 1, (7.1) where the operator is zero outside the output support of a. The constant may depend on the fixed chart, phase, amplitude and p, but not on N or f.
